items.title: Meta Ads: $201.10 spend, 16 leads, $12.57 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: The last meta-ads.json on this branch covered through 2026-09-07, so this run widened to a 4-day catch-up window (2026-09-08 to 2026-09-11) to close the gap. Across those 4 days Meta spent $201.10, all on the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 16 leads at $12.57 CPL — in line with the 7-day baseline (2026-09-05 to 2026-09-11: $345.66 / 27 leads, ~$12.80 CPL), so no anomaly. Account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged DISAPPROVED/WITH_ISSUES.

needs_attention: Last prior meta-ads.json visible on this branch is 2026-09-08 (window ending 2026-09-07); no evidence in ingest/ or run-ledger.json that 2026-09-08 through 2026-09-11 were ever pulled, so today's window was widened to 4 days (capped at 7) to cover the gap. This repo has a documented history of 'gaps' that were actually branch-isolation artifacts (real runs stranded on unmerged session branches, per run-ledger.json's 2026-08-29/09-03/09-08 notes) — this session had no other branches and no gh access to check, so the gap could not be ruled out as one of those; flagging rather than assuming either way.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 16 for this window and 27 for the 7-day baseline, exactly matching the counted lead totals both times, same as flagged on 2026-08-31, 09-02, and 09-07/09-08). No discrepancy in the counted total so far, but this is a recurring pattern across many consecutive runs — the script's lead-action set should be extended rather than continuing to hand-note it.
